title: Answer: a brain alone sufficing, or no causal role for synchrony

statements.text: The view would be undermined if a minimal neural system, apart from a self-sustaining body, sufficed for creature consciousness, which is the hypothesis that must be rejected to prefer the brainbound view, or if large-scale synchrony and its downward effects proved to have no causal role.

sources.quote: hypothesis is the one that needs to be rejected in order to reject Enactive in favor
Testing this proposal will require studies of neural dynamics that are not simply correlative, but causal.
